title: The Condition and Tendencies of Technical Education in Germany

The book delves into the classification of technical schools, including continuation schools (Fortbildungsschulen), trade schools (Fachschulen), and higher technical schools (Technische Hochschulen). It discusses the evolution and current state of these institutions, highlighting their role in enhancing the industrial capabilities of Germany. Chamberlain emphasizes the significance of technical education in promoting economic growth and responding to the competitive pressures of global markets.
